chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Exile is from one town to another town." And he said: "ʿAlī عليه السلام had indeed exiled two men from al-Kūfah to al-Baṣrah."

key_terms.النَّفْيُ: banishment or exile as a legal penalty
key_terms.الْبَصْرَةِ: the city to which the two men were exiled
key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: the city from which the two men were exiled
key_terms.بَلْدَةٍ: a town or locality to which or from which a person is moved
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, cited here as the legal authority and precedent

ai.seo_question: What does exile mean in the hadd punishment, and how did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام apply it?
ai.summary: This hadith defines exile as transfer from one town to another. It also cites the practice of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, who exiled two men from al-Kūfah to al-Baṣrah, indicating a concrete application of this legal punishment.
